market_view: Month-end close with VIX +3.3% and IWM -1.9% confirming defensive/cyclical pressure — market regime neutral but small-cap weakness and energy strength suggest rotation not broad selloff. SLV ITM is the only critical issue; SPY and QQQ have sufficient cushion.

SLV 61.5/60.5p.reasoning: Short strike 2.3% ITM with worst-case fill 0.75 representing 1.36x credit — this has been CRITICAL for multiple consecutive cycles with zero execution, and every minute of inaction risks SLV moving further ITM toward max loss on a $45 BPR spread. This is not a close call.

SPY 738/728p.reasoning: 24 DTE means the 21 DTE hard exit rule triggers Thursday September 3 open — mid at 0.83 is only 21% profit, well short of the 50% target, so this must be rolled or closed before the DTE wall hits.

QQQ 679/670p.reasoning: QQQ at 717 sits 5.3% above the 679 short strike with 29 DTE — opened today, mid 0.895 near flat to 1.01 credit, no rules triggered and structure has comfortable cushion despite today's -0.57% move.
